title: Joomla Extension - balbooa.com - Stored XSS in reviews via inconsistent sanitization in Gridbox < 2.20.5.0…
description: A stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in the Joomla extension Gridbox versions prior to 2.20.5.0. The flaw arises from inconsistent sanitization of user-submitted reviews, allowing malicious scripts to be stored and executed in the context of users viewing these reviews.
